# Precision Radon Mitigation

> Licensed and insured residential radon mitigation serving Western Pennsylvania.

## Services

- Residential radon mitigation systems
- Sub-slab depressurization
- Radon mitigation fan systems
- Crawlspace vapor barriers
- Foundation sealing and crack repair

## Service area

Armstrong, Butler, Cambria, Fayette, Somerset and Westmoreland counties in Pennsylvania.

## Credentials and guarantees

- Pennsylvania DEP certification 3696
- NRPP certification 115003-RMS
- Five-year warranty on labor and installation
- Thirteen-month guarantee on post-mitigation system performance
